title: Three-Minute Lock
description: Immediately wrap into a tight, full-body cuddle lock and stay still for 3 minutes.

title: Chest Heartbeat
description: Rest your head directly over your partner's chest and listen to their heartbeat slow down.

title: Water Delivery
description: Bring your partner a fresh, cold glass of water and hold it for them while they drink.

title: Warm Towel Care
description: Use a warm, damp towel to gently clean and care for your partner.

title: No-Screen Snuggle
description: Set a 30-minute timer, pull the covers up, and snuggle with zero phones or screens.

title: Ten Facial Kisses
description: Hold your partner's face in your hands and give them ten soft kisses across their forehead and cheeks.

title: Peaceful Hair Stroke
description: Gently stroke your partner's hair while breathing together in total peace.

title: Favorite Moment Query
description: Ask your partner: 'What was your absolute favorite moment or card from tonight?'

title: Lazy Back Circles
description: Trace light, lazy circles on your partner's back or shoulder while they relax against you.

title: Three Love Declarations
description: Whisper three sincere things you deeply love about your relationship.

title: Interlocked Recovery
description: Lay side-by-side holding hands with interlocked fingers until your heart rates slow down.

title: Body Comfort Scale
description: Ask your partner: 'How does your body feel right now on a scale of 1 to 10?'

title: Stomach Lower Back Rub
description: Give your partner a slow, gentle lower back rub while they rest on their stomach.

title: Shoulder Head Rest
description: Pull your partner's head onto your shoulder and wrap both arms tightly around them.

title: Nose Kiss Gratitude
description: Kiss the tip of your partner's nose and say, 'Thank you for tonight.'

title: Stomach Initial Trace
description: Lightly trace your initials onto your partner's stomach with your fingertip.

title: Repeat Wish
description: Ask your partner: 'Is there anything we did tonight that you'd love to repeat next time?'

title: Palms Over Hearts
description: Place your palm flat over your partner's heart and let them place theirs over yours.

title: Five Silent Minutes
description: Keep the lights dim, close your eyes, and cuddle in complete silence for 5 minutes.

title: Rear Spoon Kisses
description: Kiss your partner's neck and shoulders while spooning them from behind.

title: Foot Tension Release
description: Softly massage your partner's feet or calves to release any lingering physical tension.

title: Playful Memory Share
description: Share one sweet or funny thought that popped into your head while playing tonight.

title: Warm Blanket Burrito
description: Wrap your partner up like a burrito in a warm blanket and pull them close.

title: Temple Kiss & Hair Brush
description: Brush stray hair away from your partner's forehead and press a long kiss to their temple.

title: Surprise Card Inquiry
description: Ask your partner: 'Which card surprised you the most tonight?'

title: Chest Waist Lock
description: Lay chest-to-chest with your arms locked around each other's waist for 5 minutes.

title: Wrist Kiss to Cheek
description: Kiss your partner's inner wrist and hold their hand against your cheek.

title: Desired Praise
description: Tell your partner one specific way they made you feel desired tonight.

title: Cozy Clothes Fetch
description: Offer to grab your partner a cozy shirt or hoodie to slip into.

title: Tent Kiss
description: Pull the blanket over both of your heads and share one deep, slow kiss in your private tent.

title: Shoulder Squeezes
description: Take turns giving each other three gentle shoulder squeezes.

title: Collarbone Skim
description: Lightly run your fingertips over your partner's collarbones while looking into their eyes.

title: Future Plan Question
description: Ask your partner: 'What is one goal or trip you want us to plan together soon?'

title: Pinky Lip Outline
description: Trace the outline of your partner's lips with your pinky finger.

title: Scented Hand Rub
description: Give your partner a slow 2-minute hand massage using scented hand lotion.

title: Knee Stroke
description: Rest your leg across your partner's lap and let them gently stroke your knee.

title: Early Relationship Memory
description: Whisper a favorite memory from early on in your relationship.

title: One Song Breath Sync
description: Put on a single, ultra-relaxing song and focus only on feeling each other breathe.

title: Final Soft Bite
description: Softly bite your partner's lower lip one last time, followed by a sweet kiss.

title: Relaxation Scale
description: Ask your partner to rate their current relaxation level from 1 to 10.

title: Front-to-Back Comb
description: Gently comb your fingers through your partner's hair from front to back.

title: Knuckle Kisses
description: Hold your partner's hand and kiss every single one of their knuckles.

title: Full Weight Rest
description: Lay back and let your partner rest their full weight on top of you for a cozy minute.

title: Smile Inquiry
description: Ask your partner: 'What made you smile the most during our game?'

title: Thermal Breath Warmup
description: Lightly blow cold air on your partner's neck, then warm it back up with a kiss.

title: Seated Stretch Assist
description: Offer your partner a quick neck and shoulder stretch while sitting up together.

title: Three-Point Kiss Trail
description: Give your partner three slow kisses: one on the chin, one on the lip, and one on the forehead.

title: Lucky Ear Whisper
description: Hold your partner close and whisper 'I'm so lucky to have you' into their ear.

title: Staring Contest
description: Lay side-by-side facing each other and just hold eye contact until one of you blinks.

title: Tuck In Sleep
description: Tuck the blanket around your partner's shoulders and hold them tight until they drift off.
